title: Toledo — Equation Library of the Human–AI Readout Programme
description: The permanent, coded registry of every equation in the Human–AI Readout Programme together with its Coq (Th_coqc) formalisation. Th_coqc certifies that a lemma is closed under a stated finite model's global context — an internal-consistency check, never an empirical or physical truth claim. v1.4 merges 16 newly registered readings and 7 occurrences on existing codes from the deposited paper 'The Economics of Expertise in the Age of Generative AI' v1.0.1 (10.5281/zenodo.22636999) under the weld root (weld/H.22–29, weld/W.03–10), plus the Core Epistemic Structure definitions (founder ruling BBL-2026-09-07-217) as weld/H.30–34 — 967 entries total. Ships a Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and command-line client (19 tools over stdio, a SQLite/FTS5 search index, and a static read API published on GitHub Pages) that lets an AI agent look an equation up before using it. Each entry carries an honest coq_status (closed, definition, wrapped_related, mapped_not_wrapped, open_prop, or not_formalisable). Scope: equations and Th_coqc only; papers, books and prose live in their own records and cite Toledo codes.
